about.text: Austria’s soured cream: made as sour milk is, but from cream of at least 10 % fat, and mostly from cream of 15 %, the fat it is usually sold at.

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

how.text: Cream is soured with a mesophilic lactic starter and sold without further heating, so the culture is alive. The details are the German legal standard; the Austrian Codex text could not be read, and a lexicon gives the same 10 % minimum.

steps.note: Mesophilic lactic acid bacteria of Group I (MilchPQV).

processing.text: Sold without any heating after souring, so the culture is alive.
